# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""Main publishes closed candidate compilation/CPU/lint evidence, no GPU claim."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree')
W = G / 'feat-phase-prefill-12k-20261013'
P = G / 'feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-prefill-12k-host-qualification'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase12k_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'

def load(path): return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
def safe(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict): return {k: safe(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list): return [safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value): return dict(sha256=value)
    return value

def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(safe(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

def archive(path, target): dump(target, dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-phase-prefill-12k-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(passed=False, complete=False, active=True, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, adopted=False)
    def save(): (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = load(B / 'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-root-v2/record.json')['environment']
    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED 12K PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800, rss_cap=2 << 30,
                             text_cap=4 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()
    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '499f226a0f3b46aa1bdcd0314fd0f81558799f6f'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        proof_names = ['main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-root-v1', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-root-v1',
                       'main-phase-prefill-12k-source-integration-root-v1',
                       'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-root-v2', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-root-v2',
                       'main-phase-prefill-12k-build-v3-preflight-failure',
                       'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-root-v4', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-root-v3']
        receipts = {name: load(B / name / 'record.json') for name in proof_names}
        expected_failed = {'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-root-v2', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-build-v3-preflight-failure'}
        assert all(not x['active'] for x in receipts.values())
        assert all(not x['passed'] if name in expected_failed else x['passed'] and x['complete'] for name, x in receipts.items())
        assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for x in receipts.values() for c in x['commands'])
        build = receipts['main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-root-v4']
        lint = receipts['main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-root-v3']
        assert lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings'] and build['source_pins'] == lint['source_pins']
        assert len(build['raw_startup_cases']) == 24
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == digest for name, digest in build['source_pins'].items())
        for mode in ('free', 'contrib-llvm'):
            assert m.sha(W / 'build' / mode / 'strata') == build[mode]['binary_sha256']
        names = run('dirty-source', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
        names += run('new-source', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).splitlines()
        assert set(names) == set(build['source_pins'])
        F.mkdir()
        original_pins = {}
        for name, receipt in receipts.items():
            path = B / name / 'record.json'
            original_pins[str(path)] = m.sha(path)
            compact = {k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k not in ('evidence',)}
            # Keep precise exits/ownership/recipes, only useful build/lint output.
            compact['evidence'] = {}
            for label, evidence in receipt.get('evidence', {}).items():
                if label == 'source-diff': continue
                if 'lints' in label:
                    compact['evidence'][label] = dict(summary='Findings retained separately in this original receipt and mapped comparison; full duplicate text retired.',
                        stdout_sha256=m.sha(B / name / 'commands' / (label + '.stdout')),
                        stderr_sha256=m.sha(B / name / 'commands' / (label + '.stderr')))
                else:
                    compact['evidence'][label] = evidence
            if 'source_diff_sha256' in compact: compact['source_diff_sha256'] = receipt.get('source_diff_sha256')
            dump(F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json'), dict(original_path=str(path), original_sha256=m.sha(path), record=compact))
        controllers = ['main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-v1.py', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-v1.py',
                       'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-v2.py', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-v2.py',
                       'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-v3.py', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-build-v4.py',
                       'main-phase-prefill-12k-full-lints-v3.py', 'main-phase-prefill-12k-publication-v1.py']
        for name in controllers: archive(B / name, F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'))
        report_names = ['research-gated-shared-queue-lifetime-round386-v1.txt',
                        'research-phase12k-admission-bounds-round387-v1.txt',
                        'implementation-phase-head-upload-owner-v1.txt']
        new_reports = []
        for name in report_names:
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            archive(B / 'research-20261009' / name, target)
            new_reports.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        prior = P / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-phase-cache-pair/report-registry-v190.json'
        assert load(prior)['research_completed'] == 929
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v191.json', dict(research_completed=932,
             prior=dict(path=str(prior), git_revision='7b51af7daaccf47d181f73f24590bd43d97b9b0b', sha256=m.sha(prior)),
             new_reports=new_reports, main_only_test_execution=True,
             main_corrections='Main integration receipt and report record uncertain-free and checked Runtime drain fixes, plus R386 padding correction.'))
        summary = dict(main_reviewed=True, source_parent='499f226a0f3b46aa1bdcd0314fd0f81558799f6f',
            source_pins=build['source_pins'], free=build['free'], contrib_llvm=build['contrib-llvm'],
            phase_host=build['phase-host'], phase_host_asan=build['phase-host-asan'],
            raw_startup_cases=build['raw_startup_cases'], all_24_startup_cases_passed=True,
            server_phase_lifetime_pass=True, lints_qualified=True, novel_findings=[],
            gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, quality_evaluated=False,
            full_physical262144_qualified=False, physical_fit_qualified=False,
            performance_samples=[], adopted=False, default_phase_cache=0,
            benchmark_method='Unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3; diagnostics never substitute speed samples',
            upstream_client_revision='7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d',
            research_registry_count=932,
            next_step='Main serialized actual head/alias8K then12K lifecycle/admission diagnostics; production fixed-history and full256K quality gates before adoption; matched official repetitions for unresolved decode effect')
        summary['retained_original_failures'] = ['v2 empty catch lint finding, corrected and rechecked', 'v3 controller preflight rejected earlier expected exit2, stopped before any build/test']
        summary['unchanged_engine_binary_and_startup_proof_inherited_from_v2'] = True
        dump(F / 'summary.json', summary)
        ja = """<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Phase prefill 12K 候補のビルドと CPU 検証

source-built DPC++ 7.1.1 で free と contrib-llvm をビルドしました。
変更した 11 ファイルは clang-tidy、cppcheck、文書、秘密情報、ライセンスの
検査を実際の検証済み親ソースと比較し、新規指摘はゼロでした。
両モードの所有権 CTest、別の Release と ASan / UBSan、サーバーの phase
寿命テストが通りました。空の catch の新規指摘を修正して fixture を再検査し、
親の全件検査から変わらない他のファイルの結果を引き継ぎました。元の失敗は保持しています。
管理スクリプトの事前確認が想定した exit 2 を誤って拒否した記録も残しています。
その停止時にはビルドやテストは開始していません。GPU とモデルは実行していません。

head lease、FP32 scratch alias、明示 12288 容量は既定 OFF の実験です。
元の GGUF payload を初回 H2D 前に CPU RAM に固定し、reload はその bytes を
使います。未知の copy / conversion と解放状態は owner と source を保持し、
再試行や解放を拒否します。成功した pointer は個別に消します。
lease の変換は Runtime の checked drain を使い、保存された非同期エラーと
watchdog を確認します。通常の --native の初期ガードも修正しました。

CPU fixture は allocation 1 / 2 の false / throw、copy と変換の未知状態、
同じサイズの元データ変更、destructor の fail-stop、解放前 / 後の失敗を
確認しました。両 binary で各 12 件、計 24 件の初期ガード確認も通りました。
正しい native / explicit head は意図的な普通の入力エラーまで進み、pipeline、
auto、混在容量、欠けた opt-in、01、オーバーフローは予想した位置で停止しました。
この fixture は Runtime とモデルの構築前で止まり、物理容量や DMA を証明しません。

R386、R387 と実装報告を registry v191 に追加しました。R386 の gated overlay は
まだ実装していません。現在の Alloc の padding を含めると stock 12K で別の gated
allocation を取り除くソース上の差は 503316736 bytes（480 MiB + 256）です。
物理 VRAM と速度の測定ではありません。Main は実装報告から、解放失敗の扱いと
Runtime drain を追加修正しました。具体的な指摘と元の報告は保存しています。

速度比較は引き続き変更していない上流 bench.sh --long --runs 3 で行います。
今回、新しい速度試行はありません。既定 OFF を維持し、実機の head / alias / 12K
admission、固定履歴の logit / state、全物理 262144 と restore を確認してから採否を
判断します。過去の生成文の完全一致を品質の一般条件にはしません。
"""
        en = """<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Phase prefill 12K candidate builds and CPU checks

Built free and contrib-llvm with source-built DPC++ 7.1.1. All eleven changed
files passed the no-new-findings comparison against the actual qualified parent:
clang-tidy, cppcheck, document, secret and license checks. Both owner CTests,
separate Release and ASan / UBSan checks, and server phase lifetime tests passed.
The empty-catch finding was corrected and the fixture rechecked; unchanged files inherit
the full preceding checks. Original failures remain retained, including a controller
preflight that wrongly refused an expected exit2 before any build/test began. No GPU or
model execution occurred.

Head lease, FP32 scratch aliases and explicit capacity 12288 remain default-OFF
experiments. Original GGUF payload bytes are snapshotted in CPU RAM before the
first H2D and reused on reload. Unknown copy, conversion or release state retains
owners and source and refuses retry/free. Each confirmed released pointer is
cleared separately. Lease conversion uses Runtime checked drain, stored async
error checking and the watchdog. Canonical --native raw admission was fixed.

CPU fixtures cover allocation 1 / 2 false/throw, unknown copy/conversion, same-size
source mutation, destructor fail-stop and failures before/after free. Each mode
also passed twelve actual binary startup cases,24 total. Correct native/explicit
head reaches an intentionally invalid ordinary option; pipeline, auto, mixed
capacity, missing opt-in,01 and overflow stop at their expected guards. These
fixtures stop before Runtime/model construction and prove no physical fit or DMA.

Registry v191 adds R386,R387 and the implementation report. Gated overlay remains
unimplemented. Including the current Alloc padding, removing the separate gated
allocation at stock12K would reduce requested storage by503316736 bytes,480 MiB
plus256. This is source accounting, not physical VRAM or speed. Main additionally
fixed uncertain free handling and the checked Runtime drain. Original reports and
specific findings remain retained.

Speed comparisons still use unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3. This
work adds no speed sample. Keep default OFF pending actual head/alias/12K admission,
fixed-history logits/state, full physical262144 and restore qualification. Exact
generated prose identity is not a universal quality gate.
"""
        (F / 'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
        deletions = []
        for name, receipt in receipts.items():
            for label, evidence in receipt.get('evidence', {}).items():
                for kind in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
                    path = B / name / 'commands' / (label + '.' + kind)
                    if path.exists():
                        assert path.read_text() == evidence[kind]
                        deletions.append(dict(path=str(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(path),
                            replacement='Original immutable receipt plus committed command/exit/findings evidence and source',
                            reason='Closed successful duplicate command output; original receipt preserves exact bytes'))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', dict(owner='Main', deletions=deletions, deleted=False,
             original_pinned_receipts_retained=True, byte_budget=2 << 20,
             consumer='Actual head/alias12K model qualification and fixed-history/full-context comparison',
             next_review='After first model candidate qualification or superseding source', active_runs_touched=False))
        files = [str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        assert 'skipped (' not in run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(path) == digest for path, digest in original_pins.items())
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == digest for name, digest in build['source_pins'].items())
        for row in deletions:
            assert m.sha(row['path']) == row['sha256']
        for row in deletions: Path(row['path']).unlink()
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', dict(owner='Main', deletions=deletions, deleted=True,
             removed_files=len(deletions), removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in deletions),
             original_pinned_receipts_retained=True, byte_budget=2 << 20,
             consumer='Actual head/alias12K model qualification and fixed-history/full-context comparison',
             next_review='After first model candidate qualification or superseding source', active_runs_touched=False))
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *build['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'feat(xe): guard 12K phase prefill and retain original head upload ownership'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'feat/phase-prefill-12k-20261013'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_registry_count=932,
                 removed_files=len(deletions), removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in deletions))
    except BaseException as error: r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc()); save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','commit','research_registry_count')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
